title: Matricaria chamomilla tea for medicinal use
intro: Matricaria chamomilla tea is a popular herbal infusion made from the dried flowers of the chamomile plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its calming and soothing properties. This tea is often consumed to alleviate symptoms such as anxiety, insomnia, and digestive discomfort. It is also applied topically to reduce inflammation and promote skin healing. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its ability to support relaxation and ease stress-related ailments.
